label: the first-load condition forgets there is nothing read yet, so a refresh replaces turns with a skeleton (R-rn-conversation-skeleton)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationView.loading.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: a refresh that already has turns keeps them and draws no skeleton"

label: the skeleton container is no reader stop, so a slow first load is silent to VoiceOver (R-rn-conversation-skeleton)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationView.loading.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: the skeleton speaks one loading word and exposes no bars to the reader"

label: the skeleton draws on every status, so a failed read shows fake message shapes instead of the error block (R-rn-conversation-skeleton)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/screens/ConversationView.loading.test.tsx -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R4: a failed first read draws the error block, not a skeleton"
